versions.changelog: v1.1.0: add Microsoft Fabric icons (curated 48px product set) alongside the core AWS/Azure/GCP/Microsoft icons; output as .excalidraw and .drawio.
Lean install: trimmed to a curated core icon set (~130 icons) so the skill installs within ClawHub limits; full ~3,900-icon set remains in the GitHub repo.
Initial release: editable Azure/AWS/GCP architecture diagrams with official vendor icons (curated core set), output as .excalidraw and .drawio.
